verses.text: Di Pharisees gather to am, with some of di scribes wey come from Jerusalem.
As dem see some of im disciples dey chop with unclean hands, wey mean say dem no wash dem hands, dem find fault.
Because di Pharisees, and all di Jews, no dey chop unless dem wash dem hands and arms well, as dem dey hold di tradition of di elders.
Dem no dey chop when dem come from di marketplace unless dem bathe, and plenty other things dey wey dem receive to hold, di washing of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.
Di Pharisees and di scribes ask am, “Why your disciples no dey waka according to di tradition of di elders, but dem dey chop bread with hands wey dem no wash?”
E answer dem, “Isaiah prophesy well about una hypocrites, as e dey write, ‘These people dey honor me with dem lips, but dem heart dey far from me.
But dem dey worship me for nothing, dey teach di commandments of men as doctrines.’
Una put aside God commandment and hold men tradition—di washing of pitchers and cups, and una dey do plenty other things like that.”
E talk to dem say, “Una dey well reject God commandment, so that una go keep una tradition.
Because Moses talk say, ‘Honor your papa and your mama;’ and, ‘Anybody wey curse im papa or mama, make dem kill am.’
But una dey talk say, ‘If person tell im papa or im mama say, anything wey you fit get from me as help na Corban,’ wey mean say dem don give am to God,
den una no allow am again to do anything for im papa or im mama,
so una dey cancel God word with una tradition wey una hand down. Una dey do plenty things like this.”
E call all di crowd come, talk to dem say, “Una all listen to me and understand.
Nothing dey outside di man wey fit make am unclean when e enter am; but di things wey dey come out of di man na dem dey make di man unclean.
If anybody get ears to hear, make e hear.”
When e enter house, leave di crowd, im disciples ask am about di parable.
E talk to dem say, “Una no understand too? Una no see say anything wey enter di man from outside no fit make am unclean,
because e no enter im heart, but im stomach, and den e go out go toilet, so e make all food clean?”
E talk say, “Wetin dey come out of di man, na im dey make di man unclean.
Because from inside, from di hearts of men, evil thoughts dey come out, adultery, sexual sins, murder, theft,
greed, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.
All these evil things dey come from inside, and dem dey make di man unclean.”
From there e get up and go di borders of Tyre and Sidon. E enter one house, and e no want make anybody know, but e no fit hide.
Because one woman wey im small daughter get evil spirit hear about am, come fall down for im feet.
Di woman na Greek, Syrophoenician by race. E beg am make e drive di evil spirit out of im daughter.
But Jesus talk to am say, “Make di pikin dem chop first until dem satisfy, because e no good to take di pikin dem bread throw am give di dogs.”
E answer am say, “Yes, Lord, but even di dogs under di table dey chop di pikin dem crumbs.”
E talk to am say, “Because of this word, go your way. Di evil spirit don go out of your daughter.”
E go im house, and find di pikin dey lie for bed, and di evil spirit don go.
Again e leave di borders of Tyre and Sidon, and come di Sea of Galilee, pass through di middle of di borders of Decapolis.
Dem bring one man to am wey be deaf and no fit talk well. Dem beg am make e put im hand on am.
E take am out from di crowd, privately, put im fingers inside im ears, spit, and touch im tongue.
E look up to heaven, sigh, and talk to am say, “Ephphatha!” wey mean, “Open!”
At once im ears open, and di thing wey tie im tongue loose, and e talk clearly.
E command dem say make dem no tell anybody, but di more e command dem, di more dem dey spread am.
Dem shock pass measure, dey talk say, “E don do everything well. E dey even make di deaf hear, and di mute talk!”
For those days, when big crowd gather again and dem no get anything to chop, Jesus call im disciples come, talk to dem say,
“Compassion dey move me for di crowd, because dem don stay with me three days now, and dem no get anything to chop.
If I send dem go dem house with empty belle, dem go faint for di way, because some of dem come from far.”
Im disciples answer am, “From where person go take get bread to satisfy these people for this wilderness?”
E ask dem, “How many loaves una get?” Dem talk say, “Seven.”
E command di crowd make dem sit down for ground; and e take di seven loaves. As e don thank God, e break dem, give im disciples to serve, and dem serve di crowd.
Dem get few small fish. As e don bless dem, e talk say make dem serve these ones too.
Dem chop and dem satisfy. Dem pick up seven baskets of broken pieces wey remain.
Di people wey chop na about 4,000. Den e send dem go.
At once e enter di boat with im disciples, and come di region of Dalmanutha.
Di Pharisees come out, begin argue with am, dey ask am for sign from heaven, dey test am.
E sigh deep for im spirit, talk say, “Why this generation dey ask for sign? Na true I dey tell una, dem no go give this generation any sign.”
E leave dem, enter di boat again, and go di other side.
Dem forget to carry bread; and dem no get more than one loaf with dem inside di boat.
E warn dem, talk say, “Pay attention: make una beware of di yeast of di Pharisees and di yeast of Herod.”
Dem dey reason with each other, talk say, “Na because we no get bread.”
Jesus know am, e talk to dem say, “Why una dey reason say na because una no get bread? Una never perceive, and never understand? Una heart still hard?
Una get eyes, una no see? Una get ears, una no hear? Una no remember?
When I break di five loaves for di 5,000, how many baskets full of broken pieces una pick up?” Dem tell am, “12.”
“When di seven loaves feed di 4,000, how many baskets full of broken pieces una pick up?” Dem tell am, “Seven.”
E ask dem, “Una never understand?”
E come Bethsaida. Dem bring one blind man to am, beg am make e touch am.
E hold di blind man hand, lead am out of di village. As e don spit for im eyes, and put hands on am, e ask am if e see anything.
E look up, talk say, “I see people; because I see dem like trees dey waka.”
Den e put hands on im eyes again. E look carefully, and e come well, and see everybody clear.
E send am go im house, talk say, “No enter di village, and no tell anybody for di village.”
Jesus go out with im disciples go di villages of Caesarea Philippi. For di way e ask im disciples, talk to dem say, “Who people dey talk say I be?”
Dem tell am, “John di Baptizer; others talk Elijah; but others talk say na one of di prophets.”
E talk to dem say, “But who una dey talk say I be?” Peter answer am, “You na Christ.”
E warn dem say make dem tell nobody about am.
E begin teach dem say di Son of Man must suffer plenty things, and di elders, di chief priests, and di scribes go reject am, dem go kill am, and after three days e go rise again.
E talk to dem openly. Peter take am aside and begin rebuke am.
But e turn round, see im disciples, rebuke Peter, talk say, “Get behind me, Satan! Because your mind no dey on di things of God, but on di things of men.”
E call di crowd come with im disciples, talk to dem say, “Anybody wey want follow me, make e deny imself, carry im cross, and follow me.
Because anybody wey want save im life go lose am; and anybody wey lose im life for my sake and for di Good News sake go save am.
Because wetin e go profit man, if e gain all di world, but e lose im life?
Because wetin man go give in exchange for im life?
Because anybody wey shame for me and for my words for this adulterous and sinful generation, di Son of Man go shame for am too, when e come with di glory of im Papa God and di holy angels.”
E talk to dem say, “Na true I dey tell una, some of una wey dey stand here no go taste death at all, until dem see God Kingdom come with power.”
After six days Jesus take Peter, James, and John with am, carry dem go up one high mountain privately by demself, and e change to another form before dem.
Im clothes shine, white pass, like snow; di kind wey nobody wey dey wash cloth for earth fit make white.
Elijah and Moses appear to dem, and dem dey talk with Jesus.
Peter answer Jesus, “Rabbi, e good say we dey here. Make we build three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
Because e no know wetin to talk, because fear full dem.
Cloud come cover dem, and one voice come out from di cloud, “This na my beloved Pikin. Listen to am.”
Sudden, as dem look round, dem no see anybody with dem again, except Jesus only.
As dem dey come down from di mountain, e command dem say make dem no tell anybody wetin dem see, until di Son of Man don rise from di dead.
Dem keep this word for dem heart, dey ask each other wetin e mean to rise from di dead.
Dem ask am, “Why di scribes dey talk say Elijah must come first?”
E talk to dem say, “Elijah dey come first, and e dey restore all things. But how e dey write about di Son of Man, say e go suffer plenty things and dem go despise am?
But I tell una say Elijah don come, and dem don do am anything wey dem want, just as e dey write about am.”
As e reach di disciples, e see big crowd around dem, and scribes dey question dem.
At once all di crowd, as dem see am, shock well well, run come greet am.
E ask di scribes, “Wetin una dey ask dem?”
One person for di crowd answer, “Teacher, I bring my son come meet you, wey get spirit wey no fit talk;
and any time e catch am, e dey throw am down, and e dey foam for mouth, grind im teeth, and dey waste away. I ask your disciples to drive am out, but dem no fit.”
E answer am, “Una generation wey no believe, how long I go dey with una? How long I go bear with una? Bring am come to me.”
Dem bring am to am. As di spirit see Jesus, at once e shake di boy hard, and di boy fall for ground, dey roll dey foam.
Jesus ask di boy papa, “How long since this start to happen to am?” E talk say, “From when e dey small.
Plenty times e don throw am inside fire and inside water to kill am. But if you fit do anything, show us compassion and help us.”
Jesus talk to am say, “If you fit believe, everything dey possible for di person wey believe.”
At once di pikin papa shout with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”
When Jesus see say crowd dey run gather, e rebuke di evil spirit, talk to am say, “You spirit wey dey make person mute and deaf, I command you, come out of am, and no enter am again!”
E shout, shake am hard, den e come out. Di pikin turn like dead person; so tay most of dem talk say, “E don die.”
But Jesus hold im hand, raise am up; and e stand up.
When e enter house, im disciples ask am privately, “Why we no fit drive am out?”
E talk to dem say, “This kind no fit come out except by prayer and fasting.”
Dem go out from there and pass through Galilee. E no want make anybody know.
Because e dey teach im disciples, talk to dem say, “Dem go hand over di Son of Man give men, and dem go kill am; and after dem don kill am, after three days e go rise again.”
But dem no understand di word, and dem fear to ask am.
E come Capernaum, and as e dey for house e ask dem, “Wetin una dey argue about for di way?”
But dem keep quiet, because for di way dem dey argue with each other about who be di greatest.
E sit down, call di 12; and e talk to dem say, “If anybody want be first, e go be last of all, and servant of all.”
E take one small pikin, put am for middle of dem. E carry am for im arms, talk to dem say,
“Anybody wey receive one of these small pikin dem for my name, e receive me, and anybody wey receive me, no be me e receive, but di one wey send me.”
John talk to am say, “Teacher, we see somebody wey no dey follow us dey drive out evil spirits for your name; and we stop am, because e no dey follow us.”
But Jesus talk say, “No stop am, because nobody go do mighty work for my name, and quickly talk bad about me.
Because anybody wey no dey against us dey on our side.
Because anybody wey give una cup of water to drink for my name, because una dey belong to Christ, na true I dey tell una, e no go lose im reward at all.
Anybody wey make one of these small ones wey believe me stumble, e go better for am if dem hang big millstone for im neck, and throw am inside sea.
If your hand dey make you stumble, cut am off. E better for you to enter life as cripple, pass to get two hands go Gehenna, enter di fire wey no fit quench,
‘where dem worm no dey die, and di fire no dey quench.’
If your foot dey make you stumble, cut am off. E better for you to enter life lame, pass to get two feet and dem throw you enter Gehenna, enter di fire wey no fit quench,
‘where dem worm no dey die, and di fire no dey quench.’
If your eye dey make you stumble, remove am. E better for you to enter God Kingdom with one eye, pass to get two eyes and dem throw you enter di Gehenna of fire,
‘where dem worm no dey die, and di fire no dey quench.’
Because dem go salt everybody with fire, and dem go season every sacrifice with salt.
Salt dey good, but if di salt lose im taste, wetin una go take season am? Make una get salt inside una, and make una dey at peace with each other.”
E get up from there, come di borders of Judea and di other side of Jordan. Crowds gather to am again. As e dey do before, e teach dem again.
Some Pharisees come meet am, ask am, “Di law allow man to divorce im wife?” dem dey test am.
E answer dem, “Wetin Moses command una?”
Dem talk say, “Moses allow make man write divorce paper and divorce di woman.”
But Jesus talk to dem say, “Na because una heart hard e write this commandment for una.
But from di beginning of creation, God make dem male and female.
For this reason man go leave im papa and mama, and join im wife,
and di two go become one flesh, so tay dem no be two again, but one flesh.
So wetin God don join together, make nobody separate.”
For di house, im disciples ask am again about di same matter.
E talk to dem say, “Anybody wey divorce im wife and marry another woman dey commit adultery against di first wife.
If woman divorce im husband and marry another man, e dey commit adultery.”
Dem dey bring small pikin dem to am so that e go touch dem, but di disciples rebuke di people wey dey bring dem.
But when Jesus see am, e vex, e talk to dem say, “Allow di small pikin dem come to me! No stop dem, because God Kingdom belong to people like these.
Na true I dey tell una, anybody wey no receive God Kingdom like small pikin no go enter am at all.”
E carry dem for im arms, bless dem, put hands on dem.
As e dey go out to di road, one man run come, kneel before am, ask am, “Good Teacher, wetin I go do so that I go inherit life wey no dey end?”
Jesus talk to am say, “Why you dey call me good? Nobody good except one, na God.
You know di commandments: ‘No kill,’ ‘No commit adultery,’ ‘No steal,’ ‘No give false testimony,’ ‘No cheat,’ ‘Honor your papa and your mama.’”
E talk to am say, “Teacher, I don keep all these things from my youth.”
Jesus look am, love am, talk to am say, “One thing you lack. Go, sell everything wey you get, give di poor, and you go get treasure for heaven; den come, follow me, carry di cross.”
But im face fall for di word, and e go away dey sad, because e get plenty property.
Jesus look round, talk to im disciples say, “E hard well well for people wey get riches to enter God Kingdom!”
Di disciples shock for im words. But Jesus answer again, “My pikin dem, e hard well well for people wey dey trust riches to enter God Kingdom!
E easy pass for camel to pass through needle eye than for rich man to enter God Kingdom.”
Dem shock pass measure, talk to am say, “Den who fit get salvation?”
Jesus look dem, talk say, “For men e no possible, but no be for God, because everything possible for God.”
Peter begin talk to am, “Look, we don leave everything and follow you.”
Jesus talk say, “Na true I dey tell una, nobody dey wey don leave house, or brothers, or sisters, or mama, or papa, or pikin dem, or land, for my sake, and for di sake of di Good News,
wey no go receive 100 times more now for this time, houses, brothers, sisters, mamas, pikin dem, and land, with persecutions; and for di age wey dey come, life wey no dey end.
But plenty wey first go be last; and di last go be first.”
Dem dey di way, dey go up to Jerusalem, and Jesus dey waka for front of dem, dem dey shock; and di people wey dey follow dey fear. E take di 12 again, begin tell dem di things wey go happen to am.
“Look, we dey go up to Jerusalem. Dem go deliver di Son of Man to di chief priests and di scribes. Dem go condemn am to death, and dem go deliver am to di Gentiles.
Dem go mock am, spit on am, whip am, and kill am. For di third day, e go rise again.”
James and John, Zebedee sons, come near am, talk say, “Teacher, we want make you do for us anything wey we go ask.”
E talk to dem say, “Wetin una want make I do for una?”
Dem talk to am say, “Grant us say one go sit for your right hand, and one for your left hand, for your glory.”
But Jesus talk to dem say, “Una no know wetin una dey ask. Una fit drink di cup wey I dey drink, or dem baptize una with di baptism wey dem baptize me with?”
Dem talk to am say, “We fit.” Jesus talk to dem say, “Na true say una go drink di cup wey I dey drink, and dem go baptize una with di baptism wey dem baptize me with;
but to sit for my right hand and for my left hand no be mine to give, but na for di people wey dem don prepare am for.”
When di ten hear am, dem begin vex against James and John.
Jesus call dem come, talk to dem say, “Una know say di people wey dem dey recognize as rulers over di nations dey rule dem like oga, and dem great ones dey use authority over dem.
But e no go be so among una, but anybody wey want become great among una go be una servant.
Anybody among una wey want be first, go be bondservant of all.
Because even di Son of Man no come make dem serve am, but to serve, and to give im life as ransom for plenty people.”
Dem come Jericho. As e dey go out from Jericho, with im disciples and big crowd, Timaeus son Bartimaeus, one blind beggar, dey sit by di road.
When e hear say na Jesus of Nazareth, e begin shout, talk say, “Jesus, you son of David, show me mercy!”
Plenty people rebuke am make e keep quiet, but e shout more, “You son of David, show me mercy!”
Jesus stand still, talk say, “Call am.” Dem call di blind man, talk to am say, “Take courage! Get up. E dey call you!”
E throw away im cloak, jump up, come meet Jesus.
Jesus ask am, “Wetin you want make I do for you?” Di blind man talk to am say, “Rabboni, make I see again.”
Jesus talk to am say, “Go your way. Your faith don make you well.” At once e receive im sight, and follow Jesus for di way.
